name: Riverbend Summer Camp at McKaig Nature Center
description_short: Full day nature camp for ages 5 to 10 on McKaig Nature Education Center's 91 wooded acres in Wayne, run by Riverbend educators in a partnership with McKaig. Two groups of 12 campers, each with two counselors, hike, stomp in the stream and catch bugs.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 a week deposit is due at booking and is a non-refundable administration fee, as are transaction fees. Tuition balances are due in full and become non-refundable on June 1.
notes: One weekly rate of $478. Hours 8:45 to 3:15, Monday to Friday; no extended care mentioned. 2027 dates are still to be announced; the hub expects mid June into July. Registration for 2027 opens December 11, 2026.
